finding: Teenage mothers in Austria had significantly poorer neonatal outcomes compared to adult mothers, including lower birth weight, lower Apgar scores, and higher perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The percentage of caesarean deliveries in the teenage group was significantly lower than in adult mothers (21.1% vs. 31.8%, p < 0.001).
birth_weight: Teenage mothers: 3216 ± 564 g, Adult mothers: 3247 ± 576 g
